props.name: as
props.description: The element or component this component should render as. Can be overwritten by `asChild`.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Change the default rendered element for the one passed as a child, merging their props and behavior.

Read our [Composition](https://www.reka-ui.com/docs/guides/composition) guide for more details.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The value of the slider when initially rendered. Single thumb may be
either a `number` (e.g. `50`) or `[50]`; multi-thumb is `number[]`.
The slider emits `update:modelValue` (and `valueCommit`) in whichever
shape the input arrived in — pass `50`, get `50` back.

props.name: dir
props.description:
The reading direction of the slider when applicable.
If omitted, inherits globally from `ConfigProvider` or assumes LTR (left-to-right) reading mode.

props.name: disabled
props.description: When `true`, prevents the user from interacting with the slider.

props.name: inverted
props.description: Whether the slider is visually inverted.

props.name: mainThreadDrag
props.description:
Drives the drag on the main thread. Defaults to on — the MT path paints
the active thumb directly from `touchmove` worklets so the gesture stays
at 60fps, and BG only sees one round-trip per gesture (a `valueCommit`
on `touchend`). Per-frame `update:modelValue` is suppressed during the
drag; consumers that need continuous updates should set this to `false`.

Auto-disabled under vitest's dual-thread harness because the SWC worklet
transform isn't wired there and `:main-thread-bindtouch*` attrs crash.

props.name: max
props.description: The maximum value for the range.

props.name: min
props.description: The minimum value for the range.

props.name: minStepsBetweenThumbs
props.description: The minimum permitted steps between multiple thumbs.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The controlled value of the slider. Can be bind as `v-model`.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the field. Submitted with its owning form as part of a name/value pair.

props.name: required
props.description: When `true`, indicates that the user must set the value before the owning form can be submitted.

props.name: thumbAlignment
props.description:
The alignment of the slider thumb.
- `contain`: thumbs will be contained within the bounds of the track.
- `overflow`: thumbs will not be bound by the track. No extra offset will
  be added.
